commonMistakesTr: Türkçede belirli tanımlık olmadığı için 'the' sık unutulur: 'Sun is hot' değil, 'The sun is hot' denir.
grammarNoteTr: Daha önce bahsedilen ya da tek olan şeyler için kullanılır; genel çoğul isimlerde kullanılmaz.

senses.label: specific thing
senses.meaningTr: belirli tanımlık (çoğu zaman çevrilmez), şu, o
senses.definitionEn: used before a noun when the listener knows which one you mean

examples.en: Can you close the window, please? It's cold.
examples.tr: Pencereyi kapatır mısın lütfen? Hava soğuk.
examples.noteTr: Hangi pencere olduğu belli, bu yüzden 'the'.

examples.en: The sun rises in the east.
examples.noteTr: Tek olan şeyler: the sun, the moon.

examples.en: I bought a shirt and a hat, but the hat was too small.
examples.tr: Bir gömlek ve bir şapka aldım ama şapka çok küçüktü.

commonMistakesTr: 'I am agree' yanlıştır; 'agree' fiil olduğu için 'I agree' denir.
grammarNoteTr: Çekimleri: am / is / are, geçmiş: was / were, V3: been.

senses.label: exist / describe
senses.definitionEn: used to say what or where someone or something is, or to describe them

examples.en: Please be quiet in the library.
examples.noteTr: Emir cümlesinde yalın hali: be quiet.

examples.en: My parents were very happy with the news.
Have you ever been to Izmir?
examples.noteTr: have been to: bir yere gitmiş olmak.

grammarNoteTr: İki kelimeyi veya cümleyi bağlar; listelerde son öğeden önce kullanılır.

senses.label: joining
senses.definitionEn: used to join two words, phrases or parts of a sentence

examples.en: I'd like a coffee and a piece of cake.
examples.tr: Bir kahve ve bir dilim kek istiyorum.

examples.en: We had dinner and then watched a film.
examples.tr: Akşam yemeği yedik ve sonra bir film izledik.

examples.en: My brother and I share a room.
examples.noteTr: Kendini sona koy: my brother and I.

grammarNoteTr: Türkçedeki -in/-ın tamlama ekine benzer: the name of the street = sokağın adı.

senses.label: belonging / part
senses.definitionEn: used to show that something belongs to or is part of something else

examples.en: What's the name of this street?
examples.noteTr: the name of X = X'in adı.

examples.en: She's one of my best friends.
examples.tr: O benim en iyi arkadaşlarımdan biri.

examples.en: Could I have a glass of water, please?
examples.tr: Bir bardak su alabilir miyim lütfen?

commonMistakesTr: Meslek söylerken 'a' unutulur: 'I am teacher' değil, 'I am a teacher' denir.
grammarNoteTr: Sesli harfle başlayan kelimelerden önce 'an' kullanılır: an apple, an hour.

senses.label: one / any
senses.definitionEn: used before a singular noun when you mention it for the first time or do not mean a particular one

examples.en: My sister is a nurse at the city hospital.
I go to the gym three times a week.
examples.tr: Haftada üç kez spor salonuna giderim.

examples.en: There's a cat sleeping on our car.
examples.tr: Arabamızın üstünde uyuyan bir kedi var.

grammarNoteTr: Yön bildirir (go to school) ve mastar yapar (to + fiil: to eat).

senses.label: direction
senses.definitionEn: used to show the place or person that someone or something moves towards

examples.en: I walk to school every morning.
Who are you talking to?
We flew from Ankara to London last summer.

senses.label: infinitive
senses.definitionEn: used before a verb to show purpose or after verbs like want and need

examples.en: I need to finish this report today.
She went to the shop to buy some bread.

commonMistakesTr: Günler için 'in' kullanılmaz: 'in Monday' değil, 'on Monday'; aylar ve yıllar için 'in' kullanılır.
grammarNoteTr: Ay, yıl, mevsim ve şehir/ülke ile: in May, in 2020, in Turkey.

senses.label: inside / time
senses.definitionEn: used to show that something is inside a place, or during a period of time

examples.en: Your keys are in your bag.
My grandmother was born in 1950.
I usually feel tired in the afternoon.

commonMistakesTr: Yaş için 'have' kullanılmaz: 'I have 20 years' değil, 'I am 20 years old' denir.
grammarNoteTr: he/she/it ile 'has'; geçmiş ve V3: had. 'have to' = zorunda olmak.

senses.label: own / possess
senses.definitionEn: to own something or to be related to someone

examples.en: I have two brothers and a sister.
examples.tr: İki erkek kardeşim ve bir kız kardeşim var.

examples.en: Does your flat have a balcony?
She has a lovely garden behind her house.
examples.tr: Evinin arkasında güzel bir bahçesi var.

senses.label: eat / experience
senses.definitionEn: used with nouns to say that someone eats, drinks or experiences something

examples.en: We usually have breakfast at seven.
Did you have a good time at the party?

commonMistakesTr: Türkçede özne düşürülebildiği için 'it' unutulur: 'Is raining' değil, 'It is raining' denir.
grammarNoteTr: Hava, saat ve mesafe cümlelerinde gizli özne olarak kullanılır: It's cold.

senses.label: thing / empty subject
senses.meaningTr: o, onu (cansız varlık veya hayvan için); çevrilmeyen özne
senses.definitionEn: used for a thing or animal already mentioned, or as the subject when talking about weather or time

examples.en: I lost my phone, but my brother found it under the sofa.
examples.tr: Telefonumu kaybettim ama kardeşim onu kanepenin altında buldu.

examples.en: It's very hot today, so let's go to the beach.
examples.tr: Bugün hava çok sıcak, hadi plaja gidelim.
examples.noteTr: Hava durumu: It's hot / It's raining.

examples.en: What time is it now?

commonMistakesTr: 'I' her zaman büyük harfle yazılır, cümle ortasında bile: 'and i' değil, 'and I'.
grammarNoteTr: Özne olarak kullanılır; nesne hali 'me'dir.

senses.label: speaker
senses.definitionEn: used by the speaker to refer to himself or herself as the subject of a verb

examples.en: I live in a small town near the sea.
examples.tr: Denize yakın küçük bir kasabada yaşıyorum.

examples.en: Can I ask you a question?
My friend and I are learning English together.
examples.tr: Arkadaşım ve ben birlikte İngilizce öğreniyoruz.

grammarNoteTr: Uzaktaki tekil şey için kullanılır; çoğulu 'those'dur. Bağlaç olarak da kullanılır: I know that...

senses.label: pointing
senses.definitionEn: used to refer to a person or thing that is not near the speaker

examples.en: Who is that man next to the door?
That's a great idea for a weekend trip!
examples.tr: Hafta sonu gezisi için bu harika bir fikir!

examples.en: I really like that blue dress in the window.
examples.tr: Vitrindeki şu mavi elbiseyi çok beğeniyorum.

senses.label: connecting clause
senses.definitionEn: used to introduce a clause that says what someone thinks, knows or says

examples.en: I'm sure that she will pass the exam.
He told me that the meeting was cancelled.

commonMistakesTr: Süre için 'since' ile karıştırılır: 'for two years' (süre), 'since 2020' (başlangıç).
grammarNoteTr: for + süre: for three hours. for + kişi: bu sana: This is for you.

senses.label: purpose / receiver
senses.definitionEn: used to say who will receive something or what the purpose of something is

examples.en: I made this cake for your birthday.
examples.tr: Bu pastayı doğum günün için yaptım.

examples.en: What's this red button on the machine for?
examples.tr: Makinedeki bu kırmızı düğme ne işe yarıyor?

examples.en: We're waiting for the bus.

senses.label: duration
senses.definitionEn: used to show how long something continues

examples.en: I've lived here for ten years.
We walked for two hours in the forest.

grammarNoteTr: Sen ve siz için aynı kelimedir. Hem tekil hem çoğul, hem özne hem nesne olarak aynı biçimdedir.

senses.label: listener
senses.definitionEn: used to refer to the person or people you are speaking or writing to

examples.en: Are you ready to order?
I'll call you after work.
You can't park here after six o'clock.
examples.tr: Saat altıdan sonra buraya park edemezsiniz.

commonMistakesTr: Türkçede 'o' cinsiyetsiz olduğu için he/she karıştırılır; erkek için 'he', kadın için 'she'.
grammarNoteTr: Fiil şimdiki geniş zamanda -s alır: he works, he goes.

senses.label: male person
senses.definitionEn: used to refer to a man, boy or male animal already mentioned

examples.en: My uncle is a pilot, and he travels a lot.
examples.tr: Amcam pilot ve çok seyahat ediyor.

examples.en: Where does he work now?
He didn't come to class yesterday.

grammarNoteTr: Birliktelik ve araç bildirir: with my sister (kız kardeşimle), with a knife (bıçakla).

senses.label: together / using
senses.definitionEn: used to show that people or things are together, or what tool is used

examples.en: I'm going to the cinema with my friends tonight.
Cut the bread with this knife.
Do you agree with me?

commonMistakesTr: Günler için 'in' değil 'on' kullanılır: on Friday, on my birthday.
grammarNoteTr: Yüzey üstü ve günler/tarihler için kullanılır: on the table, on 5 May.

senses.label: surface / day
senses.definitionEn: touching the top surface of something, or used with days and dates

examples.en: I left my glasses on the kitchen table.
The shop is closed on Sundays.
Please try to be on time tomorrow.

commonMistakesTr: 'make' ile karıştırılır: işler ve görevler için 'do' (do homework), üretmek için 'make' (make a cake).
grammarNoteTr: Soru ve olumsuzlarda yardımcı fiildir: Do you...? / I don't... Geçmiş: did, V3: done.

senses.label: perform an action
senses.definitionEn: to perform an action, job or activity

examples.en: I always do my homework after dinner.
examples.tr: Ödevimi her zaman akşam yemeğinden sonra yaparım.

examples.en: What are you doing this weekend?
She did a great job on the project.
examples.noteTr: do a good job: iyi iş çıkarmak.

senses.label: auxiliary
senses.definitionEn: used before another verb to make questions and negative sentences

examples.en: Do you speak any other languages?
We don't eat meat at home.

commonMistakesTr: 'say' ile 'tell' karıştırılır: 'say to me' ya da 'tell me' denir; 'say me' yanlıştır.
grammarNoteTr: Düzensiz: said - said. say something (to someone).

senses.label: speak words
senses.definitionEn: to speak words or express a thought or opinion

examples.en: Don't forget to say thank you.
What did the teacher say about the test?
He said he was tired and went to bed early.
examples.tr: Yorgun olduğunu söyledi ve erkenden yattı.

grammarNoteTr: Yakındaki tekil şey için kullanılır; çoğulu 'these'dir. Tanıştırırken: This is my friend.

senses.label: near thing
senses.definitionEn: used to refer to a person or thing that is near the speaker or happening now

examples.en: This is my friend Ayşe from work.
Excuse me, is this seat free?
I'm very busy this week.

grammarNoteTr: Çoğul özne; nesne hali 'them', iyelik hali 'their'. Cinsiyeti bilinmeyen tek kişi için de kullanılabilir.

senses.label: group
senses.definitionEn: used to refer to people or things already mentioned, as the subject of a verb

examples.en: My neighbours are nice, but they're very noisy.
Where do they live now, in the city centre?
examples.tr: Onlar şimdi nerede yaşıyor, şehir merkezinde mi?

examples.en: They didn't know the answer either.

commonMistakesTr: Saatlerde 'in' kullanılmaz: 'in 8 o'clock' değil, 'at 8 o'clock'.
grammarNoteTr: Saatler ve belirli noktalar için: at 5 pm, at the door, at work.

senses.label: point in place / time
senses.definitionEn: used to show an exact position or an exact time

examples.en: The film starts at eight o'clock.
I'll meet you at the station.
Is your mother at home right now?
examples.noteTr: at home / at work / at school.

grammarNoteTr: İki zıt fikri bağlar; virgülden sonra gelir.

senses.label: contrast
senses.definitionEn: used to join two ideas that are different or surprising together

examples.en: The hotel was small but very clean.
I wanted to come, but I was ill.
It's expensive, but it's worth it.

grammarNoteTr: Özne olarak kullanılır; nesne hali 'us', iyelik hali 'our'.

senses.label: speaker and others
senses.definitionEn: used by the speaker to refer to himself or herself and one or more other people

examples.en: We're going on holiday next month.
Shall we take a taxi?
We work in the same office.

commonMistakesTr: 'his' ve 'her' karıştırılır: sahibi erkekse 'his', kadınsa 'her' kullanılır.
grammarNoteTr: Erkeğe ait olanı gösterir: his car = onun (erkeğin) arabası.

senses.label: belonging to him
senses.definitionEn: belonging to or connected with a man or boy already mentioned

examples.en: Tom forgot his umbrella at the café.
Do you know his new phone number?
examples.tr: Onun yeni telefon numarasını biliyor musun?

examples.en: My father washes his car every Saturday.

grammarNoteTr: Başlangıç noktası ve köken bildirir: -den, -dan.

senses.label: starting point / origin
senses.definitionEn: used to show where something starts or where someone was born

examples.en: So, where are you from originally?
examples.noteTr: Köken sorarken: Where are you from?

examples.en: I got a postcard from my cousin.
The shop is open from nine to six.

commonMistakesTr: Olumsuz cümlede 'not' doğrudan ana fiilden önce konmaz: 'I not like' değil, 'I don't like' denir.
grammarNoteTr: be ve modal fiillerden sonra gelir: is not, can not; diğer fiillerde do/does/did + not.

senses.label: negative
senses.definitionEn: used to make a word, phrase or sentence negative

examples.en: I'm not hungry right now, thanks.
Please do not touch the paintings.
examples.noteTr: Yazılı uyarılarda 'do not' tam hali yaygın.

examples.en: Are you coming or not?

commonMistakesTr: Ulaşım araçlarıyla 'with' kullanılmaz: 'with bus' değil, 'by bus' denir.
grammarNoteTr: Ulaşım (by car), edilgen yapıda yapan (written by) ve son tarih (by Friday) için kullanılır.

senses.label: means / doer
senses.definitionEn: used to show how something is done or who does something

examples.en: I usually go to work by bus.
This song was written by a young student.
examples.tr: Bu şarkı genç bir öğrenci tarafından yazıldı.

examples.en: Please send me the file by Friday.
examples.tr: Lütfen dosyayı bana cumaya kadar gönder.

commonMistakesTr: Türkçedeki 'o' cinsiyetsiz olduğu için she/he karıştırılır; kadın için 'she' kullanılır.
grammarNoteTr: Fiil şimdiki geniş zamanda -s alır: she likes, she has.

senses.label: female person
senses.definitionEn: used to refer to a woman, girl or female animal already mentioned

examples.en: My sister lives in Bursa, and she works as a teacher.
examples.tr: Kız kardeşim Bursa'da yaşıyor ve öğretmen olarak çalışıyor.

examples.en: Is she your new neighbour?
She doesn't like coffee in the morning.

grammarNoteTr: Soru cümlelerinde seçenek sunar; olumsuzda 'or' kullanılır: I don't drink tea or coffee.

senses.label: choice
senses.definitionEn: used to connect two or more possibilities

examples.en: Would you like tea or coffee?
You can pay by card or in cash.
Hurry up, or we'll miss the train!

commonMistakesTr: 'as' ile 'like' karıştırılır: meslek/rol için 'as' (work as a doctor), benzerlik için 'like'.
grammarNoteTr: Karşılaştırmada as + sıfat + as: as tall as (kadar uzun).

senses.label: role / job
senses.definitionEn: used to describe the job, role or purpose of someone or something

examples.en: She works as a waitress in a small café.
examples.tr: Küçük bir kafede garson olarak çalışıyor.

examples.en: We used the box as a table.
As a child, I was afraid of dogs.

senses.label: comparison
senses.definitionEn: used in comparisons to say that two things are equal

examples.en: My brother is as tall as my father now.
Call me as soon as you arrive.

grammarNoteTr: Soru kelimesidir; 'what + isim' de kullanılır: What colour...?

senses.label: question word
senses.definitionEn: used to ask for information about something

examples.en: What do you want for dinner?
What time does the bank open?
I don't know what you mean.

commonMistakesTr: 'home' ile 'to' kullanılmaz: 'go to home' değil, 'go home' denir.
grammarNoteTr: Düzensiz: go - went - gone. go + -ing aktiviteler: go swimming.

senses.label: move / travel
senses.definitionEn: to move or travel from one place to another

examples.en: Let's go to the park this afternoon.
We went to Antalya for our holiday.
I'm tired, so I'm going home early.
examples.tr: Yorgunum, bu yüzden eve erken gidiyorum.

commonMistakesTr: 'their', 'there' ve 'they're' aynı okunur ama farklı yazılır; 'their' sahiplik bildirir.
grammarNoteTr: Çoğul sahiplik bildirir: their house = onların evi.

senses.label: belonging to them
senses.definitionEn: belonging to or connected with people or things already mentioned

examples.en: The children are playing in their room.
Our neighbours sold their car last week.
Do you know their address?

commonMistakesTr: 'can' sonrası 'to' gelmez: 'I can to swim' değil, 'I can swim' denir.
grammarNoteTr: Modal fiildir; -s almaz, ardından yalın fiil gelir. Olumsuz: cannot / can't.

senses.label: ability / permission
senses.definitionEn: used to say that someone is able to do something or is allowed to do it

examples.en: My little brother can swim very well.
Can I borrow your pen for a minute?
examples.tr: Kalemini bir dakikalığına ödünç alabilir miyim?

examples.en: I can't hear you, the music is too loud.

grammarNoteTr: Soru kelimesi ve ilgi zamiri olarak kullanılır: the man who lives next door.

senses.label: which person
senses.definitionEn: used to ask about a person, or to add information about a person

examples.en: Who is your favourite singer?
Who broke the kitchen window this morning?
examples.tr: Bu sabah mutfak camını kim kırdı?

examples.en: I have a friend who speaks five languages.
examples.tr: Beş dil konuşan bir arkadaşım var.

grammarNoteTr: Düzensiz: get - got - got/gotten (ABD). Çok anlamlıdır: almak, olmak, varmak.

senses.label: receive / obtain
senses.definitionEn: to receive, buy or obtain something

examples.en: I got a message from my boss this morning.
examples.tr: Bu sabah patronumdan bir mesaj aldım.

examples.en: Where can I get a ticket for the concert?
Could you get some milk on your way home?
examples.tr: Eve gelirken biraz süt alır mısın?

senses.label: become / arrive
senses.definitionEn: to change to a new state, or to arrive somewhere

examples.en: It's getting dark, let's go inside.
What time did you get home last night?
examples.tr: Dün gece eve saat kaçta vardın?

commonMistakesTr: 'if' cümlesinde gelecek zaman kullanılmaz: 'If it will rain' değil, 'If it rains' denir.
grammarNoteTr: Koşul bildirir: If + geniş zaman, will + fiil.

senses.label: condition
senses.definitionEn: used to say that one thing happens only when another thing happens

examples.en: If it rains tomorrow, we'll stay at home.
You can call me if you need help.
I'm not sure if he's coming.

grammarNoteTr: Modal fiildir; ardından yalın fiil gelir. Kısa hali: 'd (I'd like).

senses.label: polite request / imagined
senses.definitionEn: used to make polite requests and offers, or to talk about imagined situations

examples.en: Would you like something to drink?
I would love to visit Japan one day.
examples.tr: Bir gün Japonya'yı ziyaret etmeyi çok isterim.

examples.en: If I had more time, I would learn the guitar.
examples.tr: Daha çok zamanım olsaydı gitar öğrenirdim.

commonMistakesTr: 'her' hem 'onun (kadın)' hem 'onu/ona (kadın)' demektir; 'she' ile karıştırılmamalı: 'I saw she' değil, 'I saw her'.
grammarNoteTr: İyelik (her bag) ve nesne (I know her) olarak kullanılır.

senses.label: belonging to her / object
senses.definitionEn: belonging to a woman or girl already mentioned, or used as the object form of she

examples.en: Maria lost her keys again.
I saw her at the supermarket yesterday.
Have you met her husband?

grammarNoteTr: Çoğul ve sayılamayan isimlerle kullanılır: all students, all the water.

senses.label: every one / whole
senses.definitionEn: the whole amount or every one of a group

examples.en: All my friends came to the wedding.
I was at home all day because of the rain.
Did you eat all the biscuits?

grammarNoteTr: İyelik sıfatıdır; isimden önce gelir: my book = kitabım.

senses.label: belonging to me
senses.definitionEn: belonging to or connected with the speaker

examples.en: My name is Deniz, and I'm from Trabzon.
Have you seen my phone anywhere?
I'm staying with my grandparents this summer.

commonMistakesTr: 'do' ile karıştırılır: 'do a mistake' değil, 'make a mistake' denir.
grammarNoteTr: Düzensiz: make - made - made. make someone + fiil: birine bir şey yaptırmak.

senses.label: create / produce
senses.definitionEn: to produce or create something

examples.en: I'll make some sandwiches for the trip.
Everyone makes mistakes when they learn a language.
This chair was made by my grandfather.

senses.label: cause
senses.definitionEn: to cause someone to feel something or to do something

examples.en: That film made me cry.
Loud music makes me nervous.

commonMistakesTr: 'discuss' ile 'about' kullanılmaz: 'discuss about the plan' değil, 'discuss the plan' denir.
grammarNoteTr: Konu (hakkında) ve yaklaşık sayı (about 20 = yaklaşık 20) bildirir.

senses.label: topic
senses.definitionEn: on the subject of something

examples.en: This book is about a girl who travels in time.
examples.tr: Bu kitap zamanda yolculuk yapan bir kız hakkında.

examples.en: What are you talking about?
How about a walk after lunch?
examples.tr: Öğle yemeğinden sonra yürüyüşe ne dersin?

senses.label: approximately
senses.definitionEn: a little more or less than a number

examples.en: The trip takes about two hours.
There were about fifty people at the meeting.

commonMistakesTr: Durum fiilidir; 'I am knowing' denmez, 'I know' denir.
grammarNoteTr: Düzensiz: know - knew - known. 'k' okunmaz.

senses.label: have information
senses.definitionEn: to have information in your mind, or to be familiar with someone

examples.en: Do you know where the station is?
I've known Selin since primary school.
Let me know if you need anything.
examples.tr: Bir şeye ihtiyacın olursa bana haber ver.

commonMistakesTr: 'will' sonrası 'to' gelmez: 'I will to go' değil, 'I will go' denir.
grammarNoteTr: Gelecek zaman modalidir; kısa hali 'll, olumsuzu won't.

senses.label: future
senses.definitionEn: used to talk about the future or to make a promise or offer

examples.en: I think it will rain this evening.
Don't worry, I'll help you with the boxes.
examples.tr: Merak etme, kutular için sana yardım edeceğim.

examples.en: Will you be at the meeting tomorrow?

grammarNoteTr: Birçok deyimsel fiil oluşturur: get up, look up, turn up.

senses.label: higher position
senses.definitionEn: towards a higher place or position

examples.en: Please stand up when the teacher comes in.
examples.tr: Öğretmen içeri girince lütfen ayağa kalkın.

examples.en: We climbed up the hill to see the view.
What time do you usually get up?

grammarNoteTr: Sayı olarak 'bir'; isim tekrarını önlemek için zamir olarak da kullanılır: the blue one.

senses.label: number 1
senses.definitionEn: the number 1

examples.en: I have one brother and no sisters.
examples.tr: Bir erkek kardeşim var, kız kardeşim yok.

examples.en: One day, I want to live by the sea.
examples.tr: Bir gün deniz kenarında yaşamak istiyorum.

examples.en: Can I have one more slice of pizza?
examples.tr: Bir dilim pizza daha alabilir miyim?

senses.label: replacing a noun
senses.definitionEn: used instead of repeating a noun that has already been mentioned

examples.en: I don't like this shirt; I prefer the blue one.
examples.tr: Bu gömleği beğenmiyorum; mavi olanı tercih ederim.

examples.en: Which one do you want?

commonMistakesTr: Saat sorarken 'What time is it?' denir; 'How many time' yanlıştır, 'How many times' (kaç kez) veya 'How much time' (ne kadar süre) doğrudur.
grammarNoteTr: Süre anlamında sayılamaz (much time); 'kez' anlamında sayılabilir (three times).

senses.label: hours and minutes
senses.definitionEn: the thing measured in minutes, hours, days and years

examples.en: I don't have much free time during the week.
examples.tr: Hafta içi pek boş vaktim olmuyor.

examples.en: What time does the film start?
We had a great time at the beach.
examples.noteTr: have a great time: çok eğlenmek.

senses.label: occasion
senses.definitionEn: an occasion when something happens

examples.en: This is my first time in Istanbul.
I've watched this film three times.

commonMistakesTr: 'var' cümlelerinde 'have' kullanılır: 'In the room have a bed' değil, 'There is a bed in the room' denir.
grammarNoteTr: There is + tekil, There are + çoğul: 'var' anlamı verir.

senses.label: exists
senses.definitionEn: used with be to say that something exists or is present

examples.en: There is a good bakery near my house.
examples.tr: Evimin yakınında iyi bir fırın var.

examples.en: Are there any eggs in the fridge?
There weren't many people at the concert.

senses.label: that place
senses.definitionEn: in, at or to that place

examples.en: Put the box over there, next to the door.
I love Rome; I went there last year.
examples.tr: Roma'yı çok seviyorum; geçen yıl oraya gittim.

grammarNoteTr: Yaş söylerken: I'm 25 years old. 'this year, last year' ile edat kullanılmaz.

senses.label: twelve months
senses.definitionEn: a period of twelve months, or the time from 1 January to 31 December

examples.en: We moved to Izmir last year.
My son is seven years old.
Happy New Year to you and your family!

grammarNoteTr: Sıfat ve zarfı güçlendirir (so tired); bağlaç olarak sonucu bildirir (so = bu yüzden).

senses.label: very
senses.definitionEn: used to make an adjective or adverb stronger

examples.en: I'm so tired after that long walk.
examples.tr: O uzun yürüyüşten sonra çok yorgunum.

examples.en: Thank you so much for your help!
examples.noteTr: Thank you so much: çok teşekkürler.

examples.en: Is it really so difficult?

senses.label: result
senses.definitionEn: used to say what happens as a result of something

examples.en: It was raining, so we took a taxi.
examples.tr: Yağmur yağıyordu, bu yüzden taksiye bindik.

examples.en: The shop was closed, so I went home.
examples.tr: Dükkan kapalıydı, o yüzden eve gittim.

commonMistakesTr: Fikir bildirirken 'I am thinking that...' yerine 'I think that...' denir.
grammarNoteTr: Düzensiz: think - thought - thought. 'th' sesi dil dişler arasında çıkarılır.

senses.label: have an opinion
senses.definitionEn: to have an opinion or belief about something

examples.en: I think this restaurant is too expensive.
What do you think about my new haircut?
I don't think he will come today.

commonMistakesTr: 'when' zaman cümlesinde gelecek zaman kullanılmaz: 'when I will arrive' değil, 'when I arrive' denir.
grammarNoteTr: Soru kelimesi (ne zaman) ve zaman bağlacı (-dığında) olarak kullanılır.

senses.label: at what time / at the time
senses.definitionEn: used to ask at what time something happens, or to say at what time it happens

examples.en: When is your sister's birthday party?
examples.tr: Kız kardeşinin doğum günü partisi ne zaman?

examples.en: Call me when you get to the hotel.
I lived in Germany when I was a child.

grammarNoteTr: Sınırlı seçenekler arasında sorar; ilgi zamiri olarak nesneler için kullanılır.

senses.label: choice / relative
senses.definitionEn: used to ask about one or more from a limited number of things, or to add information about a thing

examples.en: Which bus goes to the airport?
Which do you prefer, the red or the green?
examples.tr: Hangisini tercih edersin, kırmızıyı mı yeşili mi?

examples.en: This is the book which changed my life.

commonMistakesTr: Nesne konumunda 'they' kullanılmaz: 'I called they' değil, 'I called them' denir.
grammarNoteTr: 'they' zamirinin nesne halidir; fiil ve edatlardan sonra gelir.

senses.label: object form of they
senses.definitionEn: used as the object of a verb or preposition to refer to people or things already mentioned

examples.en: I love these shoes, but I can't afford them.
examples.tr: Bu ayakkabılara bayılıyorum ama onları almaya param yetmiyor.

examples.en: Where are the kids? I can't see them.
I sent them an email this morning.
examples.tr: Bu sabah onlara bir e-posta gönderdim.

commonMistakesTr: Olumsuz ve soru cümlelerinde genellikle 'any' kullanılır: 'I don't have some' değil, 'I don't have any'.
grammarNoteTr: Olumlu cümlelerde ve kibar tekliflerde kullanılır: Would you like some tea?

senses.label: an amount
senses.definitionEn: an amount or number of something that is not stated exactly

examples.en: I need some eggs to make the cake.
examples.tr: Keki yapmak için biraz yumurtaya ihtiyacım var.

examples.en: Would you like some more soup?
Some people prefer to work at night.
examples.tr: Bazı insanlar gece çalışmayı tercih eder.

commonMistakesTr: Özne konumunda 'me' kullanılmaz: 'Me and Ali went' yerine 'Ali and I went' doğru kabul edilir.
grammarNoteTr: 'I' zamirinin nesne halidir; fiil ve edatlardan sonra gelir.

senses.label: object form of I
senses.definitionEn: used as the object of a verb or preposition to refer to the speaker

examples.en: Can you help me with this bag?
examples.tr: Bu çantayla bana yardım edebilir misin?

examples.en: Excuse me, where is the bus stop?
My mum always waits for me after school.
examples.tr: Annem okuldan sonra beni hep bekler.

commonMistakesTr: 'people' çoğuldur: 'people is' değil, 'people are' denir; 'peoples' çoğunlukla yanlıştır.
grammarNoteTr: 'person' kelimesinin çoğuludur: one person, two people.

senses.label: persons
senses.definitionEn: men, women and children; more than one person

examples.en: There were too many people on the bus.
How many people are coming to dinner?
People in this town are very friendly.
examples.tr: Bu kasabadaki insanlar çok cana yakın.

commonMistakesTr: 'take a shower/photo' yerine 'make a shower/photo' denmez.
grammarNoteTr: Düzensiz: take - took - taken. Süre bildirir: It takes an hour.

senses.label: carry / move
senses.definitionEn: to carry or move something or someone from one place to another, or to get hold of it

examples.en: Don't forget to take an umbrella.
I took my daughter to the dentist yesterday.
Can you take a photo of us, please?
examples.tr: Bizim bir fotoğrafımızı çeker misiniz lütfen?

senses.label: need time / use transport
senses.definitionEn: to need a certain amount of time, or to travel using a vehicle

examples.en: It takes twenty minutes to walk to school.
Let's take the train instead of driving.

grammarNoteTr: Birçok deyimsel fiil oluşturur: go out, find out, run out of.

senses.label: away from inside
senses.definitionEn: away from the inside of a place or container

examples.en: Let's go out for dinner tonight.
She took her phone out of her bag.
Is your father out at the moment?

commonMistakesTr: Hareket bildirirken 'in' yerine 'into' gerekir: 'He walked in the room' değil, 'He walked into the room'.
grammarNoteTr: Bir yerin içine doğru hareket bildirir; değişim için de kullanılır: turn into.

senses.label: to the inside
senses.definitionEn: moving to the inside of a place or container

examples.en: She walked into the room and sat down.
Put the dirty clothes into the washing machine.
The rain turned into snow at night.

grammarNoteTr: Present perfect ile 'az önce' anlamı: I've just eaten.

senses.label: very recently
senses.definitionEn: a very short time ago

examples.en: I've just finished my homework.
The bus has just left.
Have you just arrived from the airport?

senses.label: only / simply
senses.definitionEn: only, or simply

examples.en: I'm just looking, thank you.
Wait just a minute, please.

commonMistakesTr: 'see' ile 'watch' karıştırılır: TV ve maç için 'watch' kullanılır; 'see TV' denmez.
grammarNoteTr: Düzensiz: see - saw - seen. Durum fiili olarak sürekli zamanda pek kullanılmaz.

senses.label: notice with eyes
senses.definitionEn: to notice people or things with your eyes

examples.en: I saw a beautiful bird in the garden.
Can you see the sign over there?
See you tomorrow at the bus stop!

senses.label: understand
senses.definitionEn: to understand what someone means

examples.en: Oh, I see what you mean now.
examples.tr: Ha, şimdi ne demek istediğini anlıyorum.

examples.en: Do you see the problem?

commonMistakesTr: Nesne konumunda 'he' kullanılmaz: 'I know he' değil, 'I know him' denir.
grammarNoteTr: 'he' zamirinin nesne halidir.

senses.label: object form of he
senses.definitionEn: used as the object of a verb or preposition to refer to a man or boy

examples.en: I called him, but he didn't answer.
Did you give him the money?
My brother is coming, so I'm waiting for him.
examples.tr: Kardeşim geliyor, o yüzden onu bekliyorum.
examples.noteTr: Edattan sonra nesne hali: for him.

commonMistakesTr: 'your' ile 'you're' karıştırılır: 'your' = senin, 'you're' = you are.
grammarNoteTr: Tekil ve çoğul için aynıdır: senin / sizin.

senses.label: belonging to you
senses.definitionEn: belonging to or connected with the person or people being spoken to

examples.en: What's your favourite colour for clothes?
Please write your name at the top of the page.
examples.tr: Lütfen adınızı sayfanın en üstüne yazın.

examples.en: Is this your jacket on the chair?

commonMistakesTr: Konuşanın yanına hareket için 'come', uzağa hareket için 'go' kullanılır; 'I'm going!' yerine çağrıya cevapta 'I'm coming!' denir.
grammarNoteTr: Düzensiz: come - came - come.

senses.label: move towards
senses.definitionEn: to move towards the speaker or to the place where the speaker is

examples.en: Come here and look at this!
My cousins came to visit us last weekend.
examples.tr: Kuzenlerim geçen hafta sonu bizi ziyarete geldi.

examples.en: Are you coming to the party on Saturday?

grammarNoteTr: 'can' fiilinin geçmişi ve daha kibar halidir; ardından yalın fiil gelir.

senses.label: past ability / polite request / possibility
senses.definitionEn: used to talk about past ability, to make polite requests, or to say something is possible

examples.en: Could you open the door for me, please?
examples.tr: Kapıyı benim için açabilir misiniz lütfen?

examples.en: When I was five, I could already read.
We could go to the museum tomorrow.

grammarNoteTr: Şimdiki zamanla sık kullanılır: I'm working now.

senses.label: at present
senses.definitionEn: at the present time

examples.en: I'm busy now; can I call you later?
examples.tr: Şimdi meşgulüm; seni sonra arayabilir miyim?

examples.en: We need to leave right now.
She lives in Canada now.

commonMistakesTr: Karşılaştırmada 'from' kullanılmaz: 'bigger from' değil, 'bigger than' denir.
grammarNoteTr: Karşılaştırma sıfatından sonra gelir: older than, more expensive than.

senses.label: comparison
senses.definitionEn: used after a comparative adjective or adverb to compare two things

examples.en: My brother is taller than me.
The train is faster than the bus.
It took more than an hour to get here.
examples.tr: Buraya gelmek bir saatten fazla sürdü.

commonMistakesTr: 'like' fiilinden sonra '-ing' ya da 'to' gelir; 'I like swim' yanlış, 'I like swimming' doğrudur.
grammarNoteTr: Durum fiilidir. 'would like' = isterim (kibar). Edat olarak 'gibi' anlamı da vardır.

senses.label: enjoy
senses.definitionEn: to enjoy something or think that someone or something is nice

examples.en: I like reading books before bed.
Do you like spicy food?
My cat doesn't like the rain.

senses.label: similar to
senses.definitionEn: similar to or in the same way as someone or something

examples.en: She looks like her mother.
What's the weather like in Antalya?

commonMistakesTr: Tekil isimden önce 'another', çoğuldan önce 'other' kullanılır: 'other book' değil, 'another book'.
grammarNoteTr: the other: ikisinden diğeri; others: diğerleri.

senses.label: different / remaining
senses.definitionEn: used to refer to people or things that are different from or in addition to the ones already mentioned

examples.en: Do you have this shirt in other colours?
examples.tr: Bu gömleğin başka renkleri var mı?

examples.en: One sock is here, but where is the other one?
examples.tr: Bir çorap burada ama diğeri nerede?

examples.en: We help each other with homework.

grammarNoteTr: Yöntem ve durum sorar; 'how + sıfat' ile miktar ve ölçü sorar: How old...?

senses.label: in what way / condition
senses.definitionEn: used to ask about the way something happens or someone's condition

examples.en: Hi Emma, how are you today?
How do you spell your surname?
How much does this bag cost?

commonMistakesTr: 'then' ile 'than' karıştırılır: 'then' = sonra, 'than' = -den (karşılaştırma).
grammarNoteTr: Sıralama (sonra) ve geçmiş zaman (o zaman) bildirir.

senses.label: next / at that time
senses.definitionEn: after that, or at that time in the past or future

examples.en: First I have a shower, then I make breakfast.
examples.tr: Önce duş alırım, sonra kahvaltı hazırlarım.

examples.en: I was only ten years old then.
See you on Monday; bye until then!
examples.tr: Pazartesi görüşürüz; o zamana kadar hoşça kal!

commonMistakesTr: 'its' ile 'it's' karıştırılır: 'its' = onun (sahiplik), 'it's' = it is.
grammarNoteTr: Cansız varlık veya hayvan için sahiplik: its tail = onun kuyruğu.

senses.label: belonging to it
senses.definitionEn: belonging to or connected with a thing or animal already mentioned

examples.en: The dog is wagging its tail.
This city is famous for its old bridges.
The company changed its name last year.

grammarNoteTr: 'we' zamirinin iyelik halidir: our house = evimiz.

senses.label: belonging to us
senses.definitionEn: belonging to or connected with the speaker and one or more other people

examples.en: Our flat is on the third floor.
We painted our kitchen yellow.
Have you met our new manager?

commonMistakesTr: 'two', 'to' ve 'too' aynı okunur; sayı için 'two' yazılır.

senses.label: number 2
senses.definitionEn: the number 2

examples.en: I have two cats and a dog.
examples.tr: İki kedim ve bir köpeğim var.

examples.en: The meeting will last about two hours.
Can I have two tickets for the evening show?
examples.tr: Akşam gösterisi için iki bilet alabilir miyim?

commonMistakesTr: Kısa sıfatlarla 'more' kullanılmaz: 'more cheap' değil, 'cheaper' denir.
grammarNoteTr: Uzun sıfatlarla karşılaştırma yapar: more expensive, more beautiful.

senses.label: greater amount / comparison
senses.definitionEn: a larger number or amount, or used to form comparisons of longer adjectives

examples.en: Can I have some more bread, please?
examples.tr: Biraz daha ekmek alabilir miyim lütfen?

examples.en: This phone is more expensive than mine.
You should drink more water in summer.

grammarNoteTr: 'this' kelimesinin çoğuludur; yakındaki birden çok şey için kullanılır.

senses.label: near things
senses.definitionEn: used to refer to people or things that are near the speaker, in the plural

examples.en: These shoes are too small for me.
Are these your glasses on the sofa?
Prices are very high these days.

commonMistakesTr: 'want' sonrası 'that' cümlesi kurulmaz: 'I want that you come' değil, 'I want you to come' denir.
grammarNoteTr: want + to + fiil; want + kişi + to + fiil.

senses.label: wish for
senses.definitionEn: to wish to have or do something

examples.en: I want to learn how to cook.
Do you want anything from the shop?
My parents want me to study medicine.

grammarNoteTr: the way to + yer: yol; the way to + fiil: yöntem.

senses.label: route
senses.definitionEn: the route you take to go somewhere

examples.en: Excuse me, can you tell me the way to the museum?
examples.tr: Affedersiniz, müzeye giden yolu söyleyebilir misiniz?

examples.en: I bought some flowers on the way home.
We lost our way in the old town.

senses.label: method
senses.definitionEn: a method or style of doing something

examples.en: This is the easiest way to learn new words.
examples.tr: Yeni kelimeler öğrenmenin en kolay yolu bu.

examples.en: I don't like the way he talks to people.

commonMistakesTr: 'look' ile 'see' karıştırılır; 'look' bilinçli bakmaktır ve nesneden önce 'at' alır: 'look the picture' değil, 'look at the picture'.
grammarNoteTr: look at: bakmak; look for: aramak; look + sıfat: görünmek.

senses.label: direct your eyes
senses.definitionEn: to turn your eyes towards something so that you can see it

examples.en: Look at that beautiful sunset!
I'm looking for my keys.
Who is looking after your baby today?

senses.label: seem
senses.definitionEn: to seem or appear to be something

examples.en: You look tired; did you sleep well?
That chocolate cake looks really delicious.
examples.tr: O çikolatalı pasta gerçekten çok lezzetli görünüyor.

grammarNoteTr: Sıra sayısıdır (1st); zarf olarak 'önce' anlamı da taşır.

senses.label: number one in order
senses.definitionEn: coming before all others in time or order

examples.en: This is my first visit to London.
Our office is on the first floor.
Wash your hands first, then sit down.

commonMistakesTr: 'also' genellikle cümle sonuna konmaz; ana fiilden önce gelir. Cümle sonu için 'too' kullanılır.
grammarNoteTr: Ana fiilden önce, 'be' fiilinden sonra gelir: She also plays / She is also a doctor.

senses.label: in addition
senses.definitionEn: in addition; as well

examples.en: She speaks German and also a little French.
examples.tr: Almanca konuşuyor, ayrıca biraz da Fransızca.

examples.en: My father is a teacher, and he is also a writer.
examples.tr: Babam öğretmen, aynı zamanda da yazar.

examples.en: We also need some bread and cheese.
examples.tr: Bir de biraz ekmek ve peynire ihtiyacımız var.

grammarNoteTr: Karşıtı 'old'. İsimden önce gelir: a new car.

senses.label: recently made / different
senses.definitionEn: recently made, bought or started, or not known before

examples.en: I bought a new bike last week.
examples.tr: Geçen hafta yeni bir bisiklet aldım.

examples.en: Are you new here? I haven't seen you before.
examples.tr: Burada yeni misin? Seni daha önce görmedim.

examples.en: Learning a new language takes time.
examples.tr: Yeni bir dil öğrenmek zaman alır.

commonMistakesTr: 'because' sonrası isim gelirse 'of' gerekir: 'because the rain' değil, 'because of the rain'.
grammarNoteTr: because + cümle; because of + isim.

senses.label: reason
senses.definitionEn: used to give the reason for something

examples.en: I'm late because I missed the bus.
We stayed inside because of the storm.
Why are you laughing? Because your face is funny!

grammarNoteTr: 'every day' (her gün, iki kelime) ile 'everyday' (günlük, sıfat) farklıdır.

senses.label: 24 hours / daytime
senses.definitionEn: a period of 24 hours, or the time when it is light

examples.en: I walk my dog twice a day.
examples.tr: Köpeğimi günde iki kez yürüyüşe çıkarırım.
examples.noteTr: twice a day: günde iki kez.

examples.en: What day is it today?
Have a nice day and see you soon!

commonMistakesTr: 'used to' (eskiden yapardım) ile 'be used to' (alışkın olmak) karıştırılır.
grammarNoteTr: Fiil /juz/, isim /jus/ okunur.

senses.label: employ for a purpose
senses.definitionEn: to do something with a tool, method or object for a particular purpose

examples.en: Can I use your phone for a minute?
We use this room for meetings.
I used a dictionary to check the spelling.
examples.tr: Yazımı kontrol etmek için sözlük kullandım.

commonMistakesTr: 'no' ile 'not' karıştırılır: isimden önce 'no' (no money), fiil/sıfat için 'not' (not happy).
grammarNoteTr: no + isim = not any: I have no time = I don't have any time.

senses.label: negative answer / none
senses.definitionEn: used to give a negative answer, or to say there is not any of something

examples.en: No, thank you, I'm full.
There's no milk left in the fridge.
I have no idea where he is.
examples.tr: Nerede olduğu hakkında hiçbir fikrim yok.
examples.noteTr: I have no idea: hiç bilmiyorum.

commonMistakesTr: Çoğulu düzensizdir: 'mans' değil, 'men' denir.
grammarNoteTr: Düzensiz çoğul: man - men.

senses.label: adult male
senses.definitionEn: an adult male human

examples.en: A man in a red coat asked me for directions.
examples.tr: Kırmızı paltolu bir adam bana yol sordu.

examples.en: Who is that old man on the bench?
Two men were fixing the road outside.
examples.tr: Dışarıda iki adam yolu tamir ediyordu.

commonMistakesTr: 'look for' (aramak) ile 'find' (bulmak) karıştırılır.
grammarNoteTr: Düzensiz: find - found - found. find out: öğrenmek.

senses.label: discover
senses.definitionEn: to discover where something or someone is after looking

examples.en: I can't find my wallet anywhere.
She found a great job in Ankara.
Did you find the hotel easily?

commonMistakesTr: 'here' önüne 'to' gelmez: 'come to here' değil, 'come here' denir.
grammarNoteTr: Here is / Here are: işte. 'here' yer bildirir, edat almaz.

senses.label: this place
senses.definitionEn: in, at or to this place

examples.en: I've lived here all my life.
Can you come here for a second?
Here is your coffee, enjoy!

grammarNoteTr: Adı söylenmeyen nesne, olay veya fikir için genel kelime.

senses.label: object / idea
senses.definitionEn: an object, action, idea or fact that you do not name exactly

examples.en: What's that thing on the table?
Put your things in the locker, please.
The best thing about summer is the long days.
examples.tr: Yazın en güzel yanı uzun günler.

commonMistakesTr: Kişi nesnesinden sonra 'to' kullanılmaz: 'give to me the book' değil, 'give me the book' ya da 'give the book to me'.
grammarNoteTr: Düzensiz: give - gave - given. give + kişi + şey.

senses.label: hand over
senses.definitionEn: to put something in someone's hand, or to let someone have something

examples.en: Can you give me the salt, please?
My aunt gave me a watch for my birthday.
examples.tr: Teyzem doğum günüm için bana bir saat verdi.

examples.en: Don't give up; you're almost there!

commonMistakesTr: Sayılamayan isimlerle 'many' kullanılmaz: 'many water' değil, 'much water' denir.
grammarNoteTr: Sayılabilir çoğul isimlerle kullanılır; olumlu cümlede genelde 'a lot of' tercih edilir.

senses.label: a large number
senses.definitionEn: a large number of people or things

examples.en: How many brothers and sisters do you have?
There aren't many shops in my village.
Many students find grammar difficult.
examples.tr: Birçok öğrenci dil bilgisini zor bulur.

commonMistakesTr: 'good' ile karıştırılır: fiilden sonra zarf 'well' gelir: 'She sings good' değil, 'She sings well'.
grammarNoteTr: 'good' sıfatının zarf halidir. Konuşmada düşünürken 'Well...' denir.

senses.label: in a good way
senses.definitionEn: in a good or skilful way

examples.en: She speaks English very well.
Did you sleep well last night?
Well done! You passed the test.

grammarNoteTr: Zarf olarak 'sadece', sıfat olarak 'tek' anlamı taşır: the only child = tek çocuk.

senses.label: no more than / single
senses.definitionEn: no more than a particular number or amount, or the single one of its kind

examples.en: I only have five lira left.
The shop is only open in the mornings.
She is the only person who knows the answer.

grammarNoteTr: 'that' kelimesinin çoğuludur; uzaktaki birden çok şey için kullanılır.

senses.label: far things
senses.definitionEn: used to refer to people or things that are not near the speaker, in the plural

examples.en: Who are those people outside?
Those apples look very fresh.
I miss those days at university.

commonMistakesTr: 'tell' sonrası kişi gelir: 'tell to me' değil, 'tell me' denir; 'say' ise kişiyi doğrudan almaz.
grammarNoteTr: Düzensiz: tell - told - told. tell + kişi + to + fiil: birine bir şeyi yapmasını söylemek.

senses.label: give information
senses.definitionEn: to give someone information by speaking or writing

examples.en: Can you tell me the time, please?
My grandfather told us a funny story.
examples.tr: Dedem bize komik bir hikaye anlattı.

examples.en: You should always tell the truth to your friends.

commonMistakesTr: 'very' fiili nitelemez: 'I very like it' değil, 'I like it very much' denir.
grammarNoteTr: Sıfat ve zarfları güçlendirir: very good, very quickly.

senses.label: to a high degree
senses.definitionEn: used to make an adjective or adverb stronger

examples.en: The weather is very nice today.
Thank you very much for the gift.
The test wasn't very difficult.

grammarNoteTr: Beklenmedik durumu vurgular; karşılaştırmada 'daha da' anlamı verir: even better.

senses.label: surprising emphasis
senses.definitionEn: used to show that something is surprising or more than expected

examples.en: He works every day, even on Sundays.
examples.tr: Her gün çalışıyor, pazar günleri bile.

examples.en: I didn't even know her name.
The second film was even better than the first.
examples.tr: İkinci film birincisinden daha da iyiydi.
